en: Colorized vintage street view showing a broad tree-lined boulevard with people walking and a few horse-drawn vehicles. On the right side stand ornate multi‑storey stone buildings with historicist facades; on the left is a park or garden with dense trees. A tall decorative lamppost rises near the center. Printed text at the top identifies the scene in German and Russian as a boulevard in Riga.
